name: Falling Decorations

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-15: Within Antiquated Halls

stealth.details: (expert) to notice the incipient collapse; noticing the decorations has a DC of 0.

disable: DC 28 Thievery check (expert) or DC 28 Crafting check (expert) to prevent the decorations from falling.

items.name: The Sky is Falling
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks through the space under the hanging decorations

---
Effect The little bit of disturbance is all the cracked decorations need to come dislodged. They fall, their sharp metal edges dealing 6d10+15 piercing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save save) to those underneath them.

text: Large metal moons and spears break apart and fall when a creature moves beneath them.
